# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, I need help updating an order I just placed. I accidentally had it sent to my son’s address in Washington, DC, but he’s coming back home, so I need the shipping address changed.

Also, I wanted to make a couple item changes:
- change the desk lamp to black
- change the backpack to a medium size, polyester material, and if there are multiple colors available, I’d prefer grey

My name is Ivan Khan, and my zip code is 28243. I don’t remember the email on the account, sorry.
ivan_khan_7475
